posts.name: Foxmaiden
posts.cooked:
Played a couple on Insula against Ambuscade.  Teams were Legacy, Ra, Vis, Naturalist, and AA (all baseline).  Didn't use any songs that would benefit others either time, and did damage when possible, exclusively with scherzo.  AA got the final hit both times, by coincidence.

First try was a fail.  Second try was a success.

Differences between the two:

* On the first try, AA destroyed environment targets (the T-rex and a raptor pack) with sarabande.  On the second, I didn't play it.

* On the first try, AA had all three song types in play.  On the second, I only played melody (both scherzos and one rhapsody of vigor, which I did not activate -- was going to test whether helpful songs might be a 'do not play' condition rather than 'do not activate,' but clearly not).

* On the first try, AA had both pipes and harp in play.  On the second, pipes were the only instrument.

* On the first try, the environment did almost no damage to Ambuscade.  On the second try, volcano came out early while I had Ra's flesh of the sun god out, so it did at least 21 damage to him, along with destroying a bunch of devices.  I don't think this has anything to do with the unlock, though.

* AA took more damage in a shorter time on the second, thanks to fewer redirects.  However, he lived through both, and ended at 12 and 14 hp.

* AA did less damage on the second, although his damage rate was higher because the game was shorter.

* AA did not pass any turns on the first.  He passed one play phase and two power phases on the second, skipping one entire turn and the power phase of another turn.

 

Edit:  Log of the success: https://pastebin.com/QPSw71vS
